fields.why: The text claims 'The absolute increase ... was highest among adults aged 18-49 years' but reports only endpoint percentages, not the differences. A reads the named absolute contrast; B applies 'null when values are only set side by side'; both follow the brief.

The authors name it both a 'descriptive analysis of surveillance data' and 'this ecologic analysis ... by period of variant predominance', so ecologic should be recorded (A noted it but omitted it). The title and methods ('To describe trends over time') also support trend, which B omitted.
